ValidationRule.description: Requires at least one of Email or Phone on Leads submitted via the Over-Engineered Web Form. Backstop only — client-side validation prevents normal hits.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(LeadSource, 'Over-Engineered Web Form'), ISBLANK(Email), ISBLANK(Phone) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Despite invoking all those platform features, you still didn't provide an email or phone. The architectural committee is disappointed.
